title: Dataset profile + catalog entities
description: Shapes for POST /api/datasets. `dataset_profile` is the real profileCsv() output (apps/web/src/profiles.js) returned as the upload response's `profile`; `dataset` is a row of the uploaded-dataset catalog (apps/web/schema.sql). Distinct from the per-study dataset_version contract in study.schema.json.

profile_column.description: One profiled column (a row of dataset_profile.columns). Carries the additive real-profiling fields the cockpit renders.

missing_fraction.description: Fraction of rows missing this column, rounded to 4 dp.

cardinality.description: Distinct non-blank values in the sample.

n_unique.description: Same as cardinality (kept for parity with the dataset_version column shape).

is_candidate_leakage.description: Flagged by name pattern OR near-perfect target separation.

leakage_reason.description: Present only when is_candidate_leakage is true.

profile_split.description: The suggested split profileCsv attaches. Unlike the dataset_version split, this allows the `random` fallback used when no usable creation-time column exists.

time_col.description: Present only for a time_based split.

dataset_profile.description: The `profile` object returned by POST /api/datasets (the profileCsv output). A superset of the persisted dataset_version contract plus additive fields (categorical_features, datetime_columns, sampled, per-column example_values).

row_count.description: Rows observed in the (possibly sampled) CSV.

target.description: The target column name, or null when none was supplied.

target_definition.description: A human-authored definition; null for a fresh upload.

categorical_features.description: Suggested categoricals (categorical + boolean columns). Omitted on an empty CSV.

datetime_columns.description: Detected datetime columns. Omitted on an empty CSV.

sampled.description: True when the CSV was truncated to the profiling row cap (5000).

dataset.description: A row of the `dataset` catalog (apps/web/schema.sql) — an UPLOADED dataset, distinct from the per-study dataset_version. Records the CSV's content hash and the cached profileCsv result so a study can attach to it by dataset_id.

id.description: dataset_<ulid> or a caller-supplied, sanitized id.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw CSV bytes.

target.description: Optional target hint used for leakage scoring.

profile.description: The cached profileCsv() result (stored as profile_json in D1).
